checks: ACLs: unauthorized publish and subscribe refused, wildcard grants literal, no cross-component access
LAN client -> component: QoS 1 bridged into durable pub/sub, received and acknowledged
rejected inbound: a 5000-byte LAN message is rejected and counted once (not redelivered forever); the following message arrives
component -> LAN client: published under device1/ on the local broker
broker down: 5 publications spooled on disk, delivered in order after reconnect
spool exhausted: 20 accepted, 5 refused and counted; after a daemon restart exactly the 20 spooled publications arrived in order
inbound backpressure: 23 LAN messages into a 20-message queue; refusals counted, none lost (redelivered by the broker after draining; duplicates possible at least once)
